rows.text:
The frog who dwells apart
His world is a tower buried deep
In the noisy silence
The actors inside the tower do addition
 
What a noble drama!
The one who shattered the tower's stillness
Was a neighbor who had seen the performance
"Listen, this play has left my heart unsettled for a long time"
"You must take it to the market"
"I want to share this thrill with everyone"
 
The frog who dwells apart
Puffed out its cheeks with indifference
"My drama comes from a world of addition"
"But three-quarters of all frogs"
"The ones who croak and croak"
"The ones always in tears"
"The ones always laughing till they shake"
"They live in a world of multiplication"
 
"No matter the total"
"Always three-quarters"
"Seven hundred and fifty thousandths"
